subject: Upcoming Annual Company Meeting
body: Dear Team, I am pleased to inform you that our annual company meeting is scheduled for next Friday, November 12th. The meeting will be held at our headquarters and will include updates on company performance, future goals, and team-building activities. Please mark your calendars and make sure to attend this important event. Further details and agenda will be shared shortly. Looking forward to seeing you all there. Best regards, [Your Name]
